contre: Une guidance abaissée peut être prudente ; le cours a pu intégrer la baisse avant la publication.
Les révisions des analystes suivent souvent la guidance et le cours ; elles peuvent s'inverser au trimestre suivant.
Des résultats régulièrement supérieurs aux estimations peuvent traduire des estimations prudentes plutôt qu'une accélération.

guidances.citation: We expect fourth-quarter revenue in a range of $990 million to $1.01 billion and Adjusted EBITDA of $245 million to $250 million.
We expect fourth-quarter revenue in a range of $990 million to $1.01 billion and Adjusted EBITDA of $245 million to $250 million.
•Revenue: We expect revenue of $990 million to $1.01 billion.
•Adjusted EBITDA: We expect Adjusted EBITDA of $245 million to $250 million.

•Revenue: Our fourth-quarter revenue guidance implies full-year 2026 revenue of approximately $3.61 billion to $3.63 billion, representing approximately 30% annual growth. The reduction from our prior guidance of 32% to 34% annual growth reflects the exclusion of three Federal Dedrone deployments totaling approximately $130 million that were contemplated in our prior expectations.

•Adjusted EBITDA: Our fourth-quarter Adjusted EBITDA guidance implies full-year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA of $924 million to $929 million. This represents a full-year Adjusted EBITDA margin of approximately 25.6%, a 10 basis point increase from prior margin guidance of 25.5%.
